scope: Six alternating fresh-process trials per case/version using the public macOS JavaScriptCore C API. Cold: one fresh context. Sequence: 32 serial fresh contexts/groups per process, no forced GC. Native HTTP mocks are zero-latency and callbacks drain before completion. Existing scenarios require identical byte fingerprints/request counts. Policy scenarios deliberately differ: Chinese conversion 1 to 0 HTTP, static cold 1 translation to 2 source HTTP, static cached 0 to 0. Measurements include harness/JIT/allocator overhead; they are not Loon iPhone memory, native network buffers, overlapped switching or VPN acceptance.
